live_observation_summary.conclusion: The runtime's transformation that flips info_bg_1's authoring-time horizontal grid into a vertical column does not go through ANY public CCastNode or CNode setter. It must be applied either (a) inside the CSD scene draw path itself when rendering each cast, (b) via direct memory writes that bypass the named setters, or (c) the cells themselves are repositioned via the cast hierarchy in a way the static extractor doesn't capture.
